reason: B offers the more substantive extension: moderate V-for-Mo substitution is supported by prior V-containing BCC RHEAs, can lower electronegativity/VEC while preserving multicomponent solid-solution strengthening, and includes a quantitative strength-loss limit. A is compositionally ambiguous and mainly applies the already established strategy of reducing Mo in favor of existing Nb, with less assurance that ~1700 MPa strength will be retained.
